Contact us and let us know you wish to return your mattress.
We’ll request some images of the mattress, including the fire tag and the full surface of the mattress. These images help us ensure the mattress is in a suitable condition to be donated to charity.
Once we’ve reviewed the images, we’ll help you arrange a pick-up date with your nearest collection partner.
After the mattress has been picked up by our collection partner, we’ll process your refund back to your original payment method.
